summary_1line: Krishna recounts Durvasa’s grace and begins praising Shiva, describing Rudra’s wrath at Daksha’s sacrifice and the gods’ propitiation through the Satarudriya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rudra in furious form draws his bow as the universe trembles, mountains shaking and the sky darkening while terrified gods bow before him.
In Daksha’s sacrifice hall, wrathful Rudra tears out Bhaga’s eyes and kicks Pushan, scattering the terrified gods.
Shiva prepares the cosmic arrow to destroy the triple cities, with Vishnu as the arrowhead and Brahma serving as his charioteer.
